column3: A MATERIAL TEXTURE SHEET: a 3 x 2 grid of six square texture plates on a black background with thin black gutters, 3:2 landscape image. Each plate is a flat-lit, straight-down orthographic photo-real surface sample about 2 m x 2 m, evenly lit with no shadows, no perspective, no vignette, no objects, no text inside the plates, designed to be made into seamless tiling game textures. Rich believable detail at several scales: large variation, medium structure and fine grain, with realistic wear, dirt, wetness where stated. Plates, left to right then top to bottom: (1) wet black basalt cave wall: vesicular basalt with sparse fractures and faint columnar joints, glossy water film and drip streaks; (2) dry black basalt: matte, vesicles and grain, subtle ash-grey weathering; (3) large irregular dark wet flagstone paving, stones 0.5-1.4 m, narrow dark joints with a little moss, puddle sheen; (4) polished black obsidian floor slab: glassy, large flat conchoidal facets 8-40 cm, faint grey banding; (5) rimstone travertine top surface: cream-white mineral crust with scalloped micro-terraces and tiny frilly lips, pale ochre stains; (6) black volcanic sand, wet at the bottom edge and dry at the top, glittering grains, a few small pebbles.

A PROP DESIGN REFERENCE SHEET for 3D modellers, 3:2 landscape: the following objects arranged in a clean grid on a dark charcoal studio backdrop, each shown in a FRONT view and a SIDE view next to each other (orthographic, no perspective), soft even studio light plus the warm amber glow of any lit parts, a thin white 1 m scale bar under each object, small clean English labels. Accurate believable proportions and construction details (joinery, materials), in the art direction of the attached concept images. Objects: floor andon lantern (0.45 x 0.45 x 1.05 m, hinoki frame, washi panels, pyramidal cap); hanging chochin paper lantern (0.45 m, ribbed, black top and bottom caps, cord); stone toro lantern (1.6 m, basalt, fire box with openings, curved roof cap); path post lantern (1.7 m, timber post, small box head); small wall-niche lantern (0.3 m) set in rough rock; vertical kanji signboard (2.4 m, black lacquer with gold 火山湯); indigo noren banner with white crest.

A REFERENCE SHEET of three separate eye-level views (1.6 m eye height) stacked as three horizontal panels in one 2:3 portrait image, each panel 16:9, thin black gutters, small clean label in the corner of each panel. Cinematic, consistent with the attached concept art. Panels: (1) the changing hall: calm hinoki hall, backlit shelves of folded linen yukata, wooden lockers, booths with indigo noren, a long vanity with round mirrors; (2) the treatment rooms hall: timber walkway between softly glowing shoji massage rooms around a small sunken moss garden with a niwaki pine under a light well; (3) climbing the Terrace Path on the west flank at blue hour: stone switchback stair with lanterns beside a cascade of turquoise terrace pools and waterfalls, steam, sea far below.
